info.tempestas.storm_glass: Place it on a solid block. The crystals show what the weather will do next: clear for fair weather, a few specks when a change is coming, feathery crystals when rain is close, crystals up to the cork with a violet glint when a storm is close, and cloudy sinking crystals when the rain is about to stop. Use it with an empty hand to read it, or put a comparator against it.
advancements.tempestas.weather_eye.title: Weather Eye
item.tempestas.climate_gauge.reading: Temperature %s, humidity %s. A condenser here makes: %s
info.tempestas.ember_salt_block: Heats and dries the air around it: +1.0 temperature and -0.4 humidity, fading out over 3 blocks.
info.tempestas.rime_salt_block: Chills the air around it: -1.0 temperature, fading out over 3 blocks.
info.tempestas.dewstone: Wets the air around it: +0.7 humidity, fading out over 3 blocks.
info.tempestas.climate_gauge: Use it to read the temperature and humidity where you stand and what a Weather Condenser would make there. Sneak and use it to see where each number comes from.
info.tempestas.charms: Charms go in the Curios charm slot. Each one wakes up only in its own weather, under open sky: the Ember Charm on hot clear days and in the Nether, the Rime Charm in snow, the Dew Charm in rain and the Storm Charm in thunder.
tooltip.tempestas.charm.weather.clear: Wakes on hot clear days under open sky, and in the Nether
tooltip.tempestas.charm.weather.rain: Wakes in rain, under open sky
tooltip.tempestas.charm.weather.snow: Wakes in snow, under open sky
tooltip.tempestas.charm.weather.thunder: Wakes in thunderstorms, under open sky
tooltip.tempestas.charm.ember_charm: You can't burn, and your hits set things alight
tooltip.tempestas.charm.rime_charm: You never freeze, water freezes under your feet, and your hits freeze
tooltip.tempestas.charm.dew_charm: Speed, slow healing, and crops around you grow faster
tooltip.tempestas.charm.storm_charm: Lightning can't hurt you, and a strike charges your next hit with it
sky.tempestas.rain_shower.hint: Hold it out in the rain.
sky.tempestas.dawn.hint: The first light, before the noise.
sky.tempestas.dusk.hint: The last light of the day.
sky.tempestas.first_drops.hint: Be ready before the rain is.
sky.tempestas.rainbow.hint: Look up just as the rain gives out.
sky.tempestas.calm_before.hint: The hush ahead of thunder. The glass knows.
sky.tempestas.dry_thunder.hint: Thunder where no rain can fall.
sky.tempestas.mountain_air.hint: Climb high on a clear day.
sky.tempestas.full_moon.hint: A round moon, a clear sky.
sky.tempestas.new_moon.hint: The night with no moon at all.
sky.tempestas.strange_moon.hint: Only under a moon gone wrong.
sky.tempestas.empty: The jar stays empty. This sky has no name yet.
info.tempestas.sky_jar: Use a Sky Jar outdoors to catch the sky above you, if it has a name. Each jar remembers where and when it was caught. Open it later to let that weather out for a while: rain waters crops, snow settles, thunder strikes. Skies are datapack entries, so packs can add their own.
info.tempestas.almanac: Use the almanac to see every sky, caught or not, with a hint for each one still missing. Sneak and use it to open the guide.
